Kleen (كلين) is a technology-driven logistics and operations company specializing in hygiene services, with a primary focus on laundry solutions across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Kleen provides a seamless, technology-enabled laundry experience through convenient pickup and delivery services.
Kleen operates across Khobar, Dammam, Dhahran, Riyadh, and Jeddah, with a continued focus on expansion and operational excellence.

Kleen is seeking an experienced Logistics Specialist to join its operations team in Khobar. The ideal candidate must have a strong background in fleet management, delivery applications, and vehicle rental operations.

The role is responsible for managing and optimizing daily transportation and logistics activities, ensuring efficient fleet utilization, coordinating drivers, monitoring delivery performance, and maintaining vehicle availability across operational locations.

The Logistics Specialist will oversee vehicle assignments, maintenance schedules, fuel consumption, rental agreements, driver performance, and delivery operations. The role also requires coordination with delivery platforms and third-party transportation providers to ensure smooth daily operations and cost efficiency.
Manage daily fleet operations, including vehicle allocation, utilization, and availability.
Coordinate drivers, delivery schedules, and pickup and delivery routes.
Monitor delivery applications and platforms, ensuring timely order execution.
Manage relationships with car rental companies and transportation service providers.
Track vehicle maintenance, insurance, registration, inspections, and rental agreements.
Monitor fuel consumption, mileage, vehicle expenses, and fleet operating costs.
Analyze fleet and delivery performance to identify operational improvements.
Coordinate vehicle replacements, breakdowns, accidents, and emergency transportation requirements.
Maintain accurate fleet records, reports, and documentation.
Ensure drivers comply with company policies, traffic regulations, and safety requirements.
Coordinate with operations, customer service, and branch management teams.
Support fleet expansion and transportation planning as the company grows.
Proven experience in Fleet Management, Logistics, or Transportation Operations .
Previous experience working with delivery applications and last-mile delivery platforms is highly preferred.
Experience in car rental companies, vehicle leasing, or fleet rental management is strongly preferred.
Strong knowledge of vehicle allocation, fleet utilization, and maintenance coordination.
Understanding of driver management and delivery route optimization.
Good analytical skills with the ability to monitor costs, performance, and operational KPIs.
Proficiency in Excel, reporting tools, and fleet or logistics management systems.
Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and coordinate with different operational teams.
Valid Saudi driving license is an advantage.
Diploma or bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
